works.title: SPD: A single pass. A complete ranking.
works.alt: SPD: the study’s three-item maximum-score assignment matrix
works.description: Read the user context and candidates once, then recover a complete ranking from item–position scores. Follow H → M → S, teacher-ranking distillation, and Hungarian assignment through eight cards and an interactive matrix.
works.caveat: A paper reading study. The matrices and loss slider are illustrative examples, not experiments that train a model.
works.heroAlt: SPD: the study’s three-item maximum-score assignment matrix

works.title: GenRec: An LLM-Backed Recommendation Ranker
works.alt: GenRec: contextual representation and catalog-aware scoring schematic
works.description: Read Netflix’s recommendation ranker through two training phases, catalog-aware scoring, reward weighting, and prefill-only inference. Connect what the model learns with how it produces a ranking.
works.caveat: A paper reading study. The full notes include diagrams, training details, and interpretation limits.
works.heroAlt: GenRec: contextual representation and catalog-aware scoring schematic

works.title: EmbeddingGemma 2: Audio–Text Alignment
works.alt: EmbeddingGemma 2: audio–text retrieval with Exp 1 Top-1 results
works.description: Explore audio–text embedding alignment using 221 dialogue pairs from six children. Text-to-audio Top-1 is 72.4%; audio-to-text is 65.6%. Cross-modal retrieval coexists with a strong modality signature.
works.caveat: Exp 1 only. Three pairs were reviewed directly; alignment was assumed for the remaining 218. No independent gold topic labels are available.
works.heroAlt: EmbeddingGemma 2: audio–text retrieval with Exp 1 Top-1 results

works.title: Laya vs CrossEncoder
works.alt: Laya versus CrossEncoder: measured accuracy and request latency
works.description: Compare classifiers on eight related BANKING77 payment intents and 320 held-out requests. Fine-tuned Laya reached 90.6% accuracy at 98.8 ms per request; fine-tuned CrossEncoder reached 93.4% at 208.0 ms.
works.caveat: Results apply to this experimental setup. The report documents reproduction conditions and remaining differences between the systems.
works.heroAlt: Laya versus CrossEncoder: measured accuracy and request latency

works.title: TurboQuant: Inside the KV Cache
works.alt: TurboQuant: measured KV allocation of 896 versus 357 MiB
works.description: Compare KV-cache memory, latency, and retrieval on an M1 Max with Qwen2.5-1.5B. At 30.3k input tokens, the KV cache used 357 MiB within 3,829 MiB of total Metal allocation.
works.caveat: The one-million-token chart projects KV storage only. It is not a run of this model at a one-million-token context length.
works.heroAlt: TurboQuant: measured KV allocation of 896 versus 357 MiB

works.title: Netflix Artwork Personalization
works.alt: Artwork personalization: three fictional posters from the study
works.description: Read artwork personalization through LLM post-training: connect LoRA, SFT, and DPO with the task definition, learning objectives, and choice of an image for a viewer.
works.caveat: A paper reading study with editable diagrams, source references, and a detailed explanation of the learning process.
works.heroAlt: Artwork personalization: three fictional posters from the study
